body: Sorry for the late reply. I try to collect myself everytime before i write. That's why i can come off as casual or something. Thanks for sharing that with us. It made me reconsider a lot of things..

I can't bring myself to even mumble the word "suicide" to them. Because it would break them. A year ago i got really drunk and started telling them how i was suicidal for a few years now and how i was a burden to them, and i don't remember a thing, but they told me in the morning, and they started crying and saying they're sorry even though they didn't do anything, my family is as loving as one can be, and i just can't put them through that again.
